payload.query:
query UserInfo {
  userInfo {
    ...userFields
  }
}

fragment userFields on User {
  id
  role
  login
  email
  firstName
  lastName
  phoneNumber
  avatar
  avatarSkin
  isActive
  isConfirmEmail
  isRegistrationComplete
  canReceiveConfirmationEmail
  coins
  createDate
  firstGradeDate
  freeAIQueries
  cards {
    createDate
    id
    pan
    mainCard
  }
  subscriptions {
    ...userSubscriptionFields
  }
  students {
    id
    firstName
    avatar
    attributes
    classRooms {
      id
      grade
      name
      studentName
      teacherName
      schoolName
      isClassrep
    }
    bitConfig
    firstGradeDate
    accessabilitySettings {
      themeName
      fontFamily
      fontSizeInPx
      letterSpacingIncreasingInPercent
      isClearScreen
    }
  }
  school {
    address
    name
    place
  }
  schoolPermissions {
    canEditSchool
  }
  attributes
  contractType
  externalUserSource
  limitUsage
  isGuest
  hasNewAuth
  educontSchoolName
  educontSchoolId
  educont {
    educontUid
    isActive
    role
    allowedCourses
    educationalInstitutions {
      approvedStatus
      isActual
      educationalInstitution {
        id
        shortName
        inn
        kpp
        address
        region
        typeEducationalInstitution
      }
    }
  }
  parentId
  parent {
    _id
    email
    isConfirmEmail
  }
  godMode
  permissions {
    id
    slug
    description
  }
  isFutureCode
  bitConfig
  disableBillings
  accessabilitySettings {
    themeName
    fontFamily
    fontSizeInPx
    letterSpacingIncreasingInPercent
    isClearScreen
  }
  codeOfFuturePermissions
  showAIHints
  coursesFavourites {
    courses
    modules
    units
    elements
  }
  isEducont
  hasSchoolsAccess
  educontSchool {
    schoolEmployeeId
    schoolUuid
  }
}

fragment userSubscriptionFields on UserSubscription {
  id
  allowRecurring
  cardId
  orderId
  classroomId
  status
  isActive
  activeDate
  endDate
  deleteDate
  plan {
    ...subscriptionPlanFields
  }
  nextPlan {
    ...subscriptionPlanFields
  }
  subscription {
    ...subscriptionFields
  }
}

fragment subscriptionFields on Subscription {
  id
  name
  role
  type
  description
  weight
  createDate
  updateDate
  deleteDate
  labels
  displayCardIcon
  displayCardSize
  plans {
    ...subscriptionPlanFields
  }
  discounts {
    id
    type
  }
  configuration {
    subjectIds
    categoryIds
    chatRequests
    giftChatRequests
    tasksCount
    studentsQuantityInClassroom
    unlimitedAccessToTeachersTasks
    hintsForTeachersTasks
  }
  classObjectId
  specialLabel
}

fragment subscriptionPlanFields on SubscriptionPlan {
  id
  numberOfStudents
  pricingPolicy
  period
  price
  timeline
  priceBefore
  pricePerMonth
  pricePerMonthBefore
  discount
  quotaOfTasks
  coins
  subjectPrices {
    id
    subjectId
    name
    priceBefore
    pricePerMonth
    pricePerMonthBefore
    discount
  }
  categoryPrices {
    id
    categoryId
    name
    priceBefore
    pricePerMonth
    pricePerMonthBefore
    discount
  }
}
